final_validation.change_explanation: After collection and the strict 17-file CPU audit, two pure report-validation changes were made: the dynamic-window API rejects periodic evaluation/checkpoint schedules whose subsequent window state is unmodeled, and the shared native-run validator rejects an outer schedule that disagrees with the recorded effective Trainer arguments. Training collection code is unchanged. All collected reports use eval_strategy=save_strategy=no, and all four holdout prediction dictionaries remain entirely unchanged.

limitations: All processes use the same five synthetic source records, seed and execution settings; the holdouts add real sampler epochs 25–40.
The extra-epoch descriptor stream differs from the calibration prefix; this does not establish entirely unseen shapes or independent data.
Primer runs are retained and excluded from calibration. Existing shared compilation and filesystem caches were not cleared or controlled.
Reported errors cover eligible optimizer-update windows only, not future sampler order, warmup, total pipeline time or dynamic VRAM.
Observed allocator peaks include setup, training and saving; they are not per-window peaks, non-PyTorch usage or an OOM guarantee.
Independent processes and parameter updates were verified; short synthetic runs do not validate convergence or model quality.
